definitions.explanation: The sound of thunder, typically heard during a thunderstorm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠|とお}く→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{雷鳴|らいめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I heard thunder in the distance.

examples.japanese: {雷鳴|らいめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{轟|とどろ}いた→轟く：07359_todoroku⟧。
⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{雷鳴|らいめい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{稲光|いなびかり}→稲光：27670_inabikari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覚|さ}めた→覚める：02058_sameru⟧。
examples.english: I woke up to intense thunder and lightning.

notes:
USAGE: {雷鳴|らいめい} is a more literary or formal word for thunder compared to ⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雷鳴|らいめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{轟|とどろ}く→轟く：07359_todoroku⟧ (thunder rumbles)
- {雷鳴|らいめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}く→鳴り響く：09125_narihibiku⟧ (thunder resounds)
- {雷鳴|らいめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧ (to hear thunder)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧ - thunder (more common, colloquial)
- ⟦{稲光|いなびかり}→稲光：27670_inabikari⟧ - lightning flash
- ⟦{稲妻|いなずま}→稲妻：04989_inazuma⟧ - lightning bolt
- ⟦{落雷|らくらい}→落雷：07379_rakurai⟧ - lightning strike
- ⟦{雷雨|らいう}→雷雨：15922_raiu⟧ - thunderstorm

COMPARISON: While ⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧ can refer to both thunder and lightning, {雷鳴|らいめい} specifically refers only to the sound of thunder.
